canonical_name: Drink & Draw at Perspective Café (Asheville Art Museum)
summary: A weekly drop-in sketching activity run by the Asheville Art Museum's rooftop Perspective Café: paper-covered tables and unlocked art supplies for anyone who makes a café purchase (museum admission required). It is an institutional program, not a self-organized group of returning artists.

evidence.note: All 16 listings use identical boilerplate: 'Free with Perspective Café purchase. Museum admission required... unlock the art supplies with your purchase' - no membership, dues, sign-up, or named organizers/regulars.
Tags emphasize 'Drop In', 'Drop In Activity', 'All Skill Levels', 'Museum Cafe', 'Museum Admission Required' - consistent with a venue-run drop-in program, not a club.

The Asheville Art Museum's own event page organizes and hosts it; framed as open to any visitor 'whether you're an experienced artist or just looking for a fun way to spend the afternoon' - no member/community language.
Perspective Café is the museum's rooftop café by Food Experience; search results describe it as a dining/food venue, not a social club or art collective.
